fields.description: My flight NT101 was cancelled less than an hour before departure. I was rebooked on a later flight and reached Vancouver about seven and a half hours after I was meant to. I travel with a wheelchair and had booked wheelchair assistance; nobody from the assistance team came to the new gate, so I waited in my chair at the gate area for most of the afternoon without being able to get food or reach a washroom on my own. I am asking for the compensation I am owed under the APPR, and I would like someone to look at what happened with my assistance request.
